channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Ultrawealthy worry wealth will dull heirs' drive, some withhold amounts
item.description: A Bank of America study found 61% of ultra-high-net-worth individuals are concerned about their children's motivation.

item.title: Americans say economy is bad but keep spending; midterm polls not forecast
item.description: Consumer confidence is at its lowest level since 2014, yet spending rose in August. Business leaders make the same mistake with election polls.

item.title: True Religion CEO rebuilds denim brand for Gen Z and millennials
item.description: Michael Buckley has remade the early-2000s premium-denim label with $59 jeans, bedazzled everything, and concerts.

item.title: Palantir CEO says neurodivergent workers will thrive in AI era, psychologist agrees
item.description: Psychologist Daniel Wendler cautioned against idealizing neurodivergent individuals.
